_readme: Copy this file to secrets.local.json and fill in the real values.
secrets.local.json is git-ignored -- never commit the real one.
gamejolt_pk  GameJolt private key. This is the secret worth hiding.
The game_id is public, do NOT put it here.
reserved_1   Spare slot, leave empty until you need it.
reserved_2   Spare slot, leave empty until you need it.
Slot order is part of the binary contract. Append new slots, never
reorder or remove existing ones, or every shipped build breaks.
